jel.skill.constitution.name: Constitution
jel.skill.constitution.description: Governs vitality, endurance, and sustenance. Increases maximum health, food capacity, and unlocks powerful survival traits.
jel.skill.melee.name: Melee
jel.skill.melee.description: Mastery of close-quarters combat. Improves attack damage, speed, and unlocks powerful weapon techniques.
jel.skill.mining.name: Mining
jel.skill.mining.description: Proficiency in breaking blocks. Increases mining speed and unlocks higher-tier ores.
jel.skill.defense.name: Defense
jel.skill.defense.description: The art of survival. Increases armor, knockback resistance, and unlocks damage mitigation traits.
jel.skill.archery.name: Archery
jel.skill.archery.description: Expertise with ranged weapons. Improves bow and crossbow effectiveness with specialized projectile traits.
jel.skill.agility.name: Agility
jel.skill.agility.description: Speed, finesse, and traversal. Increases movement speed, jump power, and unlocks parkour or exploration specialties.
jel.skill.magic.name: Magic
jel.skill.magic.description: Arcane knowledge and potion mastery. Enhances potion effects and unlocks damage reflection.
jel.skill.smithing.name: Smithing
jel.skill.smithing.description: Craftsmanship with metals and materials. Improves repair efficiency and crafting outcomes.
jel.skill.farming.name: Farming
jel.skill.farming.description: Agricultural expertise. Increases crop yields and farming efficiency.
jel.skill.cooking.name: Cooking
jel.skill.cooking.description: Culinary skill. Enhances food quality and nutrition from prepared meals.
jel.skill.batering.name: Bartering
jel.skill.batering.description: Trading acumen. Improves villager trade prices and unlocks better deals.
jel.skill.luck.name: Luck
jel.skill.luck.description: Fortune favors the bold. Increases loot quality and rare drop chances.
jel.branch.melee.berserker.description: Unbridled fury. Trades defense for overwhelming offensive power and bloodthirsty abilities.
jel.branch.melee.duelist.description: Precision and cunning. Focuses on sustained damage, combos, and tactical debuffs.
jel.branch.defense.fortress.description: An immovable bulwark. Maximizes damage absorption and grants passive defensive bonuses.
jel.branch.defense.sentinel.description: Active protector. Rewards skillful blocking with counter-attacks and team-wide buffs.
jel.branch.archery.sniper.description: Patient marksman. Maximizes single-shot bow damage with precision abilities.
jel.branch.archery.volley.description: Rapid-fire specialist. Enhances crossbow speed and adds devastating area effects.
jel.branch.constitution.vitality.descrip: Life force mastery. Enhances regeneration, grants death-defiance, and amplifies maximum health.
jel.branch.constitution.sustenance.descr: Hunger optimization. Maximizes food efficiency, buffs from eating, and resource conservation.
jel.branch.agility.parkour.description: Aerial supremacy. Wall kicks, dodge rolls, and explosive sprint bursts for combat mobility.
jel.branch.agility.explorer.description: Environmental mastery. Night vision, underwater agility, and tireless overworld traversal.
jel.trait.melee.bleeding_edge.descriptio: Melee hits have a chance to inflict Wither, causing the target to decay over time.
jel.trait.melee.adrenaline.description: Deal bonus damage when below 30%% health. Desperation fuels your strikes.
jel.trait.melee.critical_fury.descriptio: Critical hits deal additional bonus damage, scaling with level.
jel.trait.melee.bloodlust.description: Killing a target grants a temporary Haste buff, increasing attack speed.
jel.trait.melee.ground_slam.description: Attacks have a chance to unleash a shockwave, damaging and knocking back all nearby enemies.
jel.trait.melee.wrath.description: When health drops below a critical threshold, enter a berserker rage granting Strength, Speed, and Fire Resistance.
jel.trait.melee.life_steal.description: Heal for a percentage of melee damage dealt.
jel.trait.melee.riposte.description: When hit, chance to counter-debuff the attacker with Weakness and Slowness.
jel.trait.melee.disarm.description: Chance to disable an opponent's shield on hit, putting it on cooldown.
jel.trait.melee.combo_finisher.descripti: Every 3rd consecutive hit on the same target deals bonus damage.
jel.trait.melee.thousand_cuts.descriptio: Each hit applies stacking Poison, increasing in intensity with consecutive strikes.
jel.trait.melee.mark_of_death.descriptio: After 3 consecutive hits, mark the target with Glowing and Weakness.
jel.trait.defense.damage_reduction.descr: Passively reduces all incoming physical damage by a percentage.
jel.trait.defense.elemental_ward.descrip: Reduces damage from fire, magic, and other non-physical sources.
jel.trait.defense.fortify.description: Standing still for a short time grants bonus armor. Moving immediately removes the bonus.
jel.trait.defense.death_grace.descriptio: Chance to survive a killing blow with 1 HP, like a built-in Totem of Undying.
jel.trait.defense.thorns_nova.descriptio: When hit, release an explosion of thorns damage to all nearby attackers.
jel.trait.defense.iron_curtain.descripti: Massive damage reduction at the cost of mobility. The ultimate defensive capstone.
jel.trait.defense.parry.description: Chance to completely negate incoming melee damage.
jel.trait.defense.thorns_reflect.descrip: Reflect a percentage of melee damage back to the attacker.
jel.trait.defense.shield_bash.descriptio: While blocking, attackers receive bonus damage and knockback.
jel.trait.defense.second_wind.descriptio: When health drops to critical levels, automatically heal a percentage of max HP.
jel.trait.defense.rallying_cry.descripti: When hit, grant nearby allies Resistance and Regeneration.
jel.trait.defense.vengeful_spirit.descri: When surrounded by multiple enemies, gain bonus damage and Resistance.
jel.trait.archery.headshot.description: Arrows that strike the upper hitbox of a target deal bonus damage.
jel.trait.archery.piercing_shot.descript: Arrows have a chance to ignore armor, bypassing defense entirely.
jel.trait.archery.bow_crit.description: Fully-charged bow shots have a chance to deal double damage.
jel.trait.archery.frozen_arrow.descripti: Arrows have a chance to apply Slowness and brief Freeze on impact.
jel.trait.archery.arrow_rain.description: Summon a volley of arrows in an area around the impact point.
jel.trait.archery.rapid_reload.descripti: Reduces crossbow reload time, allowing faster follow-up shots.
jel.trait.archery.crossbow_crit.descript: Crossbow bolts have a chance to deal bonus critical damage.
jel.trait.archery.chain_bolt.description: Crossbow bolts chain to nearby enemies on impact, striking additional targets.
jel.trait.archery.explosive_bolt.descrip: Crossbow bolts have a chance to explode on impact, dealing area damage.
jel.trait.archery.auto_loader.descriptio: Chance to instantly reload the crossbow after firing.
jel.trait.agility.mob_collide.descriptio: Chance to completely dodge incoming attacks.
jel.trait.agility.wall_kick.description: Gain a jump boost when near walls, enabling wall-assisted acrobatic maneuvers.
jel.trait.agility.feather_landing.descri: Reduces fall damage taken, scaling with level.
jel.trait.agility.momentum.description: After sprinting continuously, gain a speed boost that grows with sustained movement.
jel.trait.agility.acrobat.description: Chance to dodge incoming projectiles entirely.
jel.trait.agility.sprint_surge.descripti: When sprinting, periodically gain a burst of speed (cooldown-gated).
jel.trait.agility.windrunner.description: Capstone: Permanent Speed I effect while Parkour branch is active.
jel.trait.agility.aquatic_affinity.descr: Improved underwater movement and breathing efficiency.
jel.trait.agility.sure_footed.descriptio: Reduces movement exhaustion, keeping hunger at bay during travel.
jel.trait.agility.night_eyes.description: Automatically gain Night Vision in dark areas.
jel.trait.agility.thick_skin.description: Reduces damage from environmental sources like fire, drowning, and freezing.
jel.trait.agility.glider.description: While airborne and sneaking, gain Slow Falling to glide safely.
jel.trait.agility.nomad.description: Capstone: Permanent Speed I and zero movement exhaustion.
jel.trait.magic.damage_reflection.descri: Chance to reflect a portion of incoming damage back to the attacker as magic damage.
jel.trait.magic.upgraded_effect.descript: Chance to automatically upgrade consumed potion effects to higher amplifiers.
jel.trait.constitution.natural_regen.des: Increases natural health regeneration rate, scaling with level.
jel.trait.constitution.second_wind.descr: When health drops critically low, automatically heal back to a safe threshold (cooldown-gated).
jel.trait.constitution.hearty.descriptio: Multiplicative bonus to maximum health, stacking with base health increases.
jel.trait.constitution.fortitude.descrip: Gain damage reduction when below 30%% health. Desperation hardens your resolve.
jel.trait.constitution.undying_will.desc: Survive a killing blow once, gaining temporary invulnerability and massive regeneration (long cooldown).
jel.trait.constitution.avatar_of_life.de: Capstone: Permanent Regeneration I effect while Vitality branch is active.
jel.trait.constitution.efficient_digesti: Reduces all exhaustion buildup, keeping hunger satisfied longer.
jel.trait.constitution.nourishing.descri: Food restores more hunger points than normal.
jel.trait.constitution.iron_stomach.desc: Chance to resist negative effects from food (Hunger, Poison).
jel.trait.constitution.respite.descripti: Eating food grants bonus saturation beyond the normal amount.
jel.trait.constitution.feast.description: Eating food grants a temporary Strength I buff.
jel.trait.constitution.bottomless_appeti: Capstone: Eating any food always fills saturation to maximum.
commands.jel.skill.xp.add.success.single: Added %s skill XP to %s for %s (%s levels gained)
commands.jel.skill.xp.add.success.multip: Added %s skill XP to %s for %s players
